## Overview

QIRT is a conference series devoted to quantitative infrared thermography. Its scope includes measurement methods, calibration procedures, uncertainty analysis, and quantitative interpretation of infrared data. Emissivity determination and handling are recurring methodological topics due to their role in quantitative IR measurements.
